org: BFD CRM / QDB1 (mcdynccatdev01/QDB1, test) — production URL TO_CONFIRM
notes: Per-org survey configuration for BFD CRM / QDB1 (corporate and SME customers = accounts). Same shape as provisioning/seed/*.json. The source rows are the cloud org's (org5869857f), which mirrors BFD: the names are expected to match but are verified by the runbook preflight before entry. Every value marked TO_CONFIRM has an entry in `questions`; a row carrying TO_CONFIRM must not be entered until it is answered. Sources are created INACTIVE; a System Administrator activates each one with qdb_srv_ActivateSource.

questions.question: Confirm the three source tables and their customer and type fields exist on QDB1 with these logical names, and that the customer fields look up account.
questions.evidence: Read from org5869857f metadata 2026-11-10 (Applications customer = qdb_cif_no, confirmed by the user). The cloud sandbox mirrors BFD (Debt Collection). The runbook preflight reads each name from QDB1 before entry.

questions.question: Which Applications field tells a Digital (portal) application from a Legacy one, and which value(s) mean Digital? Unknown on the cloud org too (candidates there: qdb_digitalfinancing, qdb_applicationlandedfromnumuportal, both yes/no).
questions.owner: QDB business owner + QDB1 CRM administrator

questions.question: For each survey to send, which statuscode value(s) fire it, and for which request types? On the cloud org, Disbursement 'Payment Processed' = 751090050, type Letter of Credit = 751090000, Remittance = 751090001; QDB1 values may differ even where names match.
questions.evidence: OQ-A2(b). The activation API checks the codes against QDB1's metadata.
questions.owner: QDB business owner + QDB1 CRM administrator

questions.question: Default survey language for BFD customers: en or ar?
questions.evidence: Cloud uses en. Used when the customer has no language value.

questions.question: Which account field holds the customer's preferred language (text en/ar or a choice)? Empty is a valid answer: everyone then gets the default language.
questions.evidence: OQ-A2(c). No such field is known on account; Debt Collection proposed qdb_collectionlanguage, which is not built.

questions.question: Which account field holds the customer's mobile number for SMS: telephone1, or qdb_mobile_number?
questions.evidence: account.qdb_mobile_number exists on the cloud sandbox (Debt Collection schema assessment); the Debt Collection map says account.telephone1 'or QDB field — TBD'.

questions.question: Does the SMS service pick up a Fax row from faxnumber + qdb_message_body alone, or does it also need qdb_sender, qdb_language or the To party? Fax also carries WhatsApp (rows with qdb_whatsapptemplate); a survey row leaves it empty, so it reads as SMS.
questions.evidence: Proven on cloud (B7): the engine creates the Fax row with faxnumber, qdb_message_body, regardingobjectid → account and subject. Debt Collection's Fax contract lists qdb_sender and qdb_language as optional.

questions.question: Which queue sends survey emails on QDB1? It needs an approved, enabled mailbox (Email Router or server-side sync).
questions.evidence: Readiness F9; on cloud a queue without an address failed every send.

questions.question: The customer-portal URL of the survey link page for BFD customers (the token is appended as ?token=…).
questions.evidence: OQ-A2(f); integration guide, secure-link flow. Secure links stay off until the security review (NFR-CSE-009).

questions.question: How long survey responses are kept, and whether they are then deleted or anonymised.
questions.evidence: OQ-A1, QDB Compliance. Empty = no retention pass runs.
